source.title: A Particular Set of Skills
source.description:
Krixix is a genius for sure, but he may not be too friendly if you just storm into that mountain demanding his help, to say nothing of the goons that place is likely crawling with. You'll probably want to find a way to get to him without burning the place down along the way which is likely to be pretty tricky.

If you can figure out a way to get in there without stabbing, shocking, or burning anyone that is probably a good start. I've got no real ideas myself on how to do that though, so good luck!
source.objective: Find a way to get into Blackwing Lair and speak with Master Elemental Shaper Krixix without engaging him in combat.
source.completion:
Whaddya want, can't you see I'm busy here? Wait, where'd you get that hunk of slag? I swear if those half-wit gobs down in the lab are being wasteful with my product, I'm gonna lose it!

Yeah yeah, I'm sure I could make it into something good for you, but I'm behind schedule and Vick ain't known for his patience. Now, unless you can help me clone myself or grow a bunch of extra arms, beat it. I got work to do.
